# Payal Ponkshe

Payments and fintech operator with 18+ years across Mastercard, Wirecard and regulated financial services. Independent advisor and builder working where enterprise delivery, operating models and AI-enabled systems need to become executable. Current market focus: Agentic Commerce Readiness & Enablement.

Based in Germany. Works across Europe and the UAE in English-first environments, remote or onsite.

## Positioning

Payments · AI · Transformation Execution

Payal's work sits at the point where technology strategy has to become operating reality. Her strongest domain depth is in payments, fintech and financial services; her current hands-on build work spans AI-enabled products, workflow systems and automation.

Her broader working toolkit includes n8n, Supabase, React Native and MCP integrations, alongside Anthropic Claude, Claude Code and Cowork, plus OpenAI ChatGPT, Codex and APIs across research, product design, coding, workflow implementation and production systems.

## Agentic Commerce Readiness & Enablement

Agentic Commerce is treated as a current market transition, not Payal's entire identity and not a bet on one model, agent, protocol or platform.

The current focus is helping organisations prepare commerce stacks for trusted agent-mediated buying and selling — whether the agent sits with the customer, merchant, marketplace or platform.

The Agentic Commerce Readiness Stack examines eight layers:
- Discoverable
- Interpretable
- Callable
- Authorised
- Transactable
- Fulfillable
- Governable
- Measurable & Evaluable

### Agentic Commerce Launchpad

**Assess — Agentic Commerce Readiness Sprint**
Select one or more commercially important buying, selling or operational journeys, identify where an agent-mediated experience will break, map architecture, tool, authority and evaluation gaps, and define a prioritised MVP.

**Prove — Agentic Commerce MVP**
Take one deliberately narrow journey and implement enough of the end-to-end chain to test data, tools/interfaces, authority, transaction, fulfilment, controls, observability and evaluation in practice.

**Scale — Agentic Commerce Operating Model**
Translate a proven pattern into repeatable capability across customer agents, merchant agents, products, channels, markets and teams.

Agentic Commerce page: https://payalponkshe.com/agentic-commerce

**Enterprise Delivery & Implementation Acceleration**
For B2B payments, fintech and enterprise-technology companies where customer onboarding or implementation has become slow, bespoke or difficult to scale.
